verdict.rationale: Sonar is itself a documented public API. First-party docs cover the Sonar/chat endpoint reference, Search API, Agent API, embeddings and an OpenAI-compatible router, plus a quickstart for getting an API key and making a first call. A probe confirmed a live machine-readable OpenAPI spec and llms.txt, the official GitHub Python SDK shows typed sync/async clients in use, and a community thread notes the Sonar API has been available for a long time.
